listings.shortDescription: Copy text and images. Send photos, videos and files between Android and Windows.
listings.title: Clipboard Bridge
listings.fullDescription:
Copy here. Paste there. Send the rest as files.

Clipboard Bridge connects Android and Windows without an app account, Firebase project, service-account key or maintainer relay. Find your computer on the same local network, compare the codes and confirm pairing.

CLIPBOARD FOR QUICK COPIES
Copy text or one image on Windows for automatic sending, or send manually from the tray. On Android, send clipboard text or one image from the foreground app. The image-to-clipboard picker accepts exactly one image. In another app, choose Share > Send to computer: one image goes to the PC clipboard; shared plain text waits for a Send tap.

OPEN WITH. SEND TO COMPUTER.
Choose Open with > Send to computer for a PDF, image, video or other document. The selected file goes to the computer's receiving folder, even when it is one image or a text document. Availability depends on the source app offering Android's Open with chooser. The action follows your system language; Samsung panels also display the application name.

FILES FOR EVERYTHING ELSE
Send multiple photos, videos, documents and other attachments through Android Share or the system picker. Send files saves even one selected image as a file. Windows offers a tray picker and native Share panel to send files to Android storage. Original bytes are preserved, received files are never opened automatically, and files do not replace the clipboard. Folders are not supported.

SEE PROGRESS. CHOOSE YOUR FOLDER.
Both apps show file-transfer progress and support cancellation. Success waits for the receiver to save the files and confirm. Windows saves to Downloads or a folder you choose. Android 10+ saves to Downloads/Clipboard Bridge by default, with a system folder picker also available. Android 8 and 9 require selecting a receiving folder. No broad all-files permission is needed.

File transfers use authenticated sessions issued and timed by the computer, so phone and PC clocks do not need to match. New deliberate sends can recover abandoned incomplete uploads while active transfers and files awaiting desktop saving remain protected. Clipboard messages retain their existing expiry checks.

PAUSE WHEN YOU WANT
Pause sending and receiving on Android without losing pairing. Windows tray pause stops automatic clipboard sending; deliberate file sending remains available when the phone is enabled. Nine locales follow the system language, with English fallback.

REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITS
Install the matching Windows companion from GitHub Releases or Microsoft Store. Update both apps to 0.2.2 for PC-issued file sessions. Changing between the older Windows-service edition and Store edition requires a separate pairing.

Google Play services and access to Google FCM are required. Regions or networks without Google access are currently unsupported. No idle Android foreground service is needed: Play services handles wake-ups. Active file transfers use temporary foreground work and progress notifications, which stop afterward. Windows must be running and directly reachable for file transfers and larger clipboard content.

Clipboard content supports text or one image up to 16 MiB; images travel as PNG. File batches accept 1-1,000 files without the clipboard size limit, subject to storage, connectivity and Android background limits. File sessions last up to one hour.

Transfers use authenticated encryption between approved devices. Google can process push routing metadata. No ads or analytics. Free and open source; this is a preview release.

Source, Windows downloads and support: https://github.com/c01-in/clipboard-bridge
Privacy: https://github.com/c01-in/clipboard-bridge/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
